scripts.migrate: cd backend && poetry run flask db migrate -m "$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" && poetry run flask db upgrade && cd ..
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && ([ -d migrations ] || poetry run flask db init) && poetry run flask db upgrade && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: npm run setup && concurrently "cd backend && poetry run python run.py" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
